g.text: 1 / Counts require declared population and meaning
Canonical metric selection is optional; the general fanout guard iterates SUM/AVG. Require the counted
population and measure meaning for KPIs. Test ordinary counts, distinct counts, denominators and
many-side joins; preserve valid custom extracts.
2 / Forecast completion requires the appropriate evidence
Completion requires successful execution, while the forecast descriptor is optional. Require saved
predictions and the existing forecast-evaluation contract, or return a supported partial outcome.
A successful script alone does not establish an evaluated forecast.
3 / Empty results still have declared types
For empty or all-null Snowflake results, preserve declared types rather than inferring only from values.
Demonstrate the behavior with targeted fixtures. These are code-review opportunities, not reproduced
Oct 15 read-only review. Implementation anchors: semantic_sql.py; text_to_sql/tools.py; data_analysis/tools.py; backends/snowflake.py.
